id: \bBrock: Hey \PN. Have you seen the Battle Pike over there? So many pretty girls. I could barely contain myself.
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN. Have you seen the Battle Pike over there? So many pretty girls. I could barely contain myself.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN. Hai visto la Serpe Lotta laggiù? Quante belle ragazze! Riuscivo a malapena a contenermi.

id: \bYou're going to challenge her? Well if you can't beat me you don't deserve to be wasting her time.
en: \bYou're going to challenge her? Well if you can't beat me you don't deserve to be wasting her time.
it: \bVuoi sfidare lei? Beh, se non riesci a battere me, non meriti di farle perdere tempo.

id: \bBrock: Be sure to go easy on her.
en: \bBrock: Be sure to go easy on her.
it: \bBrock: Mi raccomando, vacci piano con lei.
